MAHADEV PRASAD 								        	  Senior Design Engineer

	9740798834 	 | pudaripaapu@gmail.com |  LinkedIn |   GitHub  | Bengaluru 

 PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 

 												         Senior  Software  Engineer  with  13+  years  of  experience  in  Java  Backend  Development,  specializing  in  designing  and  implementing  scalable  REST  APIs  and  cloud-based  solutions  for  Healthcare,  Finance,  and  Energy  Management  domains. Adept  at  collaborating  with  cross-functional  teams  across  geographies  to  deliver  high-quality  software  solutions. Strong  focus  on  system  design,  performance  optimization,  and  business  impact delivery. 

						TECHNICAL SKILLS

Category Technologies / Tools Programming Languages Java Frameworks Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate, JPA Build Tool Maven Backend Development RESTful APIs, Microservices Architecture Authentication OAuth2, JWT, PingID DevOps & CI/CD Tools Jenkins, GitHub Actions Databases MySQL , PostgreSQL (Relational); MongoDB (NoSQL) Cloud & Container Platforms AWS (S3, EC2), Docker, Kubernetes Streaming & Messaging Apache Kafka, Zookeeper, ActiveMQ Monitoring & Logging Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) Other Expertise Generative AI APIs , System Design

					PROFESSIONAL  EXPERIENCE 			(13+ Years) 

Schneider Electric  |  Senior Software Engineer | 2019 Sept-Present | 6 Years                    
Projects: SelectAndConfig | eDesign-630

Led end-to-end delivery of REST APIs powering product selection for 9,000+ panel builders across Europe, collaborating with product owners, architects, and distributed teams to ensure business goals were met.



Planned and prioritized backlog items, coordinated sprints, and provided technical guidance to junior engineers, ensuring on-time delivery of critical milestones.

Developed Kafka pipelines processing 1M+ daily events, enabling real-time analytics and decoupled microservice communication.

Designed and Implemented RBAC with Spring Security + PingID, providing authorized access to all services.

Migrated Java applications to AWS EC2 + S3, cutting infrastructure costs while improving scalability.

Individual  Excellence Award for leading SDK Services for Role-Based Access. Multiple spot awards

	Technologies Used : Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Apache Kafka, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes 

Fidelity Investments  |  Senior Software Engineer | 2015 Jan -2019 Sept | 4 Yr 10 Months                                   Projects : MDM  |  SMSV  	

Developed Master Data Management (MDM) platform, integrating financial vendor data from Bloomberg, Moody’s, Reuters, S&P, Morningstar to provide real time ratings to BAs

Built  an  AWS-based  project  to  process  vendor  data  and  RDBMS  data,  applying  business  logic  to  deliver critical market event notifications to Portfolio Managers.

Played  a  key  role  in  design  changes  and  task  planning,  providing  accurate  estimations  and  in-depth  analysis for feature development.

Individual Excellence Award – Recognized for outstanding contributions to Market Events Notifications at Fidelity, demonstrating innovation and leadership.

Technologies Used:  AWS, Java, Spring Boot, ActiveMQ

Aris Global  |  Senior Software Engineer | 2010 Nov -2015 Jan |  4 Yr 2 Months				Projects : agClinical             

Integrated 5M+ client documents (PDF, Word, Excel) into AgClinical using JackRabbit CMS, expanding adoption across US & European clients.

Optimized data ingestion workflows, reducing retrieval times and enhancing user experience.

Technologies Used:  Java, J2EE, Spring, Hibernate																						    EDUCATION

			 Bachelor of Engineering (BE) in Computer Science , 2009 

 	 Visvesvaraya Technological University 

			 Pre-University Education , 2005 

		 	 Viveka Junior College, Kota
